tool_input.description: Run the receipt tests three times locally
Benchmark receipt rendering at different core counts
Benchmark receipt rendering at different core counts
Remove temp benchmark, make timing test best-of-5, run full suite

result:
The change is made and all 42 tests pass locally, but it is not committed or pushed, and I can't confirm it goes green on runner-06 — this repo has no remote, so I couldn't see the runner or pipeline history.

- **Cause:** The test compares a single cold wall-clock measurement against a fixed 250 ms budget, so the result depends on the runner's speed and load. The gift-message commit adds only one null check on the batch path, so it is not the slowdown. Locally the same batch takes about 56 ms cold and 32 ms warm on 15 cores, and about 96 ms even on a single core. My reading is that runner-06 was slow or contended, though I couldn't check that.

- **Action:** In `tests/Storefront.Specs/ReceiptTests.cs`, `Receipt_RendersBatch_WithinTimeBudget` now renders the batch 5 times and compares the fastest pass to the budget. The 250 ms budget and the 60,000 batch size are unchanged, so it still catches a real rendering regression. No production code changed.

If runner-06 is slow enough that even a warm pass exceeds 250 ms, this will still fail there. The next step would then be to move this check out of the MR pipeline rather than raise the budget.
